theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: BlackRock Gets Soft Demand for Bond Sale After AI Debt Selloff
top_news.summary: BlackRock Inc. has seen weaker-than-usual demand for a corporate bond sale tied to a Meta Platforms Inc. data center project in Texas, as investors grapple with concerns about excessive AI infrastructure spending.

top_news.title: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles as Oil Spike, AI Jitters Hit Tech Stocks
top_news.summary: The Nasdaq 100 Index tumbled Friday, capping its first back-to-back weekly loss since late March as it was dragged down by the oil-price spike and a selloff in the tech stocks that once surged on the back of the AI investment boom.

top_news.title: Dollar Wraps Its Best Week in a Month as Haven Demand Rises
top_news.summary: The dollar finished its best week in a month as investors returned to the traditional haven amid heightened geopolitical tensions.

top_news.title: Oil Prices Volatile as Supply Disruptions Hit Four Global Fronts
top_news.summary: Brent futures surged past $100 a barrel as the conflict in the Middle East widens and Ukraine strikes Russian infrastructure.

top_news.title: Wall Street Bulls Are Staring Down $100 Oil, Tariffs, AI Angst
top_news.summary: Every bull market has a recurring cast of villains. Oil shocks. Inflation. Rising bond yields. Trade wars. This week, investors had to contend with all of them at once.

top_news.title: Yen’s Worst Week Since May Brings It Close to 165 Per Dollar
top_news.summary: The yen is on track for its biggest weekly loss in more than two months, with intervention warnings doing little to deter investors betting on further weakness.

top_news.title: Global Bonds Are Reeling as Oil Surge Rekindles Inflation Threat
top_news.summary: Global bonds were pummeled this week by the latest resurgence in energy prices, delivering losses to investors who bet the worst of this year’s rout was over and teeing up credibility tests for central bankers.

top_news.title: US Cattle Herd Grows Slightly in Potential Sign of Rebuilding
top_news.summary: The US cattle herd grew modestly from the prior year, in a signal that ranchers may be starting to retain more animals following a historic shortage.

top_news.title: Colombia Rations LNG on SPEC Port Shutdown; Business, Schools Urged to Go Remote
top_news.summary: Colombia’s government is urging schools and businesses to operate remotely for several days starting next week as the nation braces for natural gas rationing during planned maintenance of its sole import terminal.

top_news.title: Hedge Funds Turn Most Negative on Canadian Dollar Since 2024
top_news.summary: Hedge funds have accumulated the most negative bets on the Canadian dollar in two years as the threat of American tariffs drags on the currency.
